verifications.claim: Rec Room is officially shutting down on June 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Rec Room will be closing down on June 1st 2026 at noon Pacific time." (R2); "shutting down on June 1" (R3); "shut down on June 1" (R4); "shutting down on June 1st" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state the shutdown date as June 1, 2026.

verifications.claim: Rec Room has over 150 million users.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "reaching over 150 million players and creators" (R2); "reached more than 150 million players" (R3); "drew more than 150 million players" (R4); "reaching more than 150 million players and creators" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All references directly confirm over/more than 150 million users/players.

verifications.claim: Rec Room announced that high operational costs and shifting market conditions led to the decision to shut down.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Our costs always ended up overwhelming the revenue"; "recent shift in the VR market, along with broader headwinds in gaming" (R2); similar phrasing in R3, R4, R5
verifications.reasoning: References directly link high costs (overwhelming revenue) and market shifts/headwinds to shutdown decision.

verifications.claim: Token purchases in Rec Room have already been halted.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "On May 1st: You will no longer be able to purchase tokens" (R2); "Token purchases will end May 1" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: References indicate token purchases halt on May 1st, not already as of announcement.

verifications.claim: Rec Room stated that costs to operate surpassed revenue.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Our costs always ended up overwhelming the revenue we brought in" (R2, quoted in R3, R4, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Direct statement in official blog, repeated across references.

verifications.claim: Rec Room stated that they could not find a sustainable path to profitability.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "we never quite figured out how to make Rec Room a sustainably profitable business"; "the path to profitability has gotten tough enough" (R2, echoed in R3, R4, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements match the claim precisely.

verifications.claim: Snap Inc. has acquired select assets from Rec Room, according to reports from The Verge and GeekWire.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Snap Inc. confirmed late Monday that it has acquired select assets from Rec Room Inc." (R3, GeekWire)
verifications.reasoning: GeekWire (R3) directly supports the acquisition; Verge (R5) omits but does not contradict.

verifications.claim: Some employees are joining Snap Inc. to work on AR initiatives, according to reports from The Verge and GeekWire.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Some of Rec Room’s employees will be joining Snap ... to support its Specs eyewear and augmented reality initiatives" (R3, GeekWire)
verifications.reasoning: GeekWire (R3) directly supports employees joining for AR; Verge (R5) omits but does not contradict.

verifications.claim: Rec Room laid off 16% of its staff in March 2025, according to GeekWire.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "cut 16% of its workforce" (R1, GeekWire, 2025 article); "laid off 16% of its staff in March 2025" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: GeekWire (R1) confirms 16% layoff in 2025 context; R4 specifies March, aligning precisely.

verifications.claim: Rec Room laid off an additional ~50% of its staff in August 2025, according to GeekWire.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "cut roughly half its remaining workforce five months later" (R4, after March=August); "laid off half of its staff in August" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: References support ~50% additional layoff around August 2025, but no direct GeekWire source; broader confirmation.

verifications.claim: As of the announcement, all monetary transactions within Rec Room have been disabled
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "as of this update ... You can no longer create new monetized UGC content"; "On May 1st: You will no longer be able to purchase tokens" (R2); token purchases end later (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Not all transactions disabled as of announcement; some like token purchases continue until May 1st.
